premise: The mechanically defined 16:00 Europe/London currency fix can temporarily concentrate predictable rebalancing flow. A fixed contrarian exposure to the immediately preceding completed four-hour FX price change at the fix may generate a positive post-fix price response, distinct from unconditional four-hour momentum. Neither favorable direction nor edge is presumed.
distinction: Not HRC1 rolling 21-hour autocorrelation or 60-minute hold, not TWC1 fitted UTC weekday/4h seasonality, not AIP1 cash index gap and first-30min activity, not MBF1 Tokyo/London GBPJPY. Exactly one daylight-saving-adjusted London fixing clock per weekday and a prespecified 120m hold; no retuning or per-symbol selection.

eligibility.clock: 16:00 Europe/London on Monday through Friday, DST-aware

scientific.pilot: Use only development unconditional 120-minute future M5 returns to estimate week-block noise scale BEFORE ever calculating directional signals or selection returns. Never view exposed audit outcomes.
scientific.economicallyRelevantMde: 1.25 times the maximum predeclared FX adverse roundtrip cost in bps; gross study impact must at least justify observed current-term adverse costs plus a 25% buffer. No generic 3bps.
scientific.effectiveSample: Informative chronological weeks, not opportunities, independent count capped by 13 selection weeks.

predictor: At 16:00 London fixing clock: if close(t)>close(t-4h), forecast SHORT; otherwise LONG if strictly lower; equality abstains. Entry only on exact t+5min close, closing exact 120 minutes later.
benchmark: Matched-clock FOUR_HOUR_MOMENTUM with opposite sign and identical entry/exit/cost; secondary ZERO_TRADE. No selection by performance.
